summary: The `gyomu-workflow` package implements the core snapshot workflow for the Gyomu CLI. It manages project validation, structure repair, pipelined workflow execution, and action runners for tasks such as docstrings, packages, and LLM context generation, while supporting state persistence via checkpoints.
responsibilities: Execute project snapshot workflows for Python projects.
Validate and repair Python project structures.
Manage workflow state and execution checkpoints.
Run pipeline actions including docstrings, packages, directories, and LLM contexts.

capabilities.name: Snapshot Workflow Orchestration
capabilities.description: Orchestrates project snapshot workflows, coordinate execution steps, manage target resolution, and run targeted processing actions.

capabilities.name: Structure Validation and Repair
capabilities.description: Validates Python project structures and request parameters, and provides automated structural repair mechanisms.

capabilities.name: State Persistence and Checkpointing
capabilities.description: Manages pipeline state persistence, step tracking, and incremental execution via checkpoints and input fingerprints.

capabilities.name: Action Runners and Processing
capabilities.description: Executes domain-specific actions including docstring processing, package analysis, LLM context generation, and documentation updates.

design_decisions: Implements a pipelined workflow architecture with checkpoints to support resumable and incremental executions.
Separates request validation and structural verification from workflow execution steps.
Delegates specialized processing tasks to dedicated action runners such as docstring updates and LLM context generation.
usage_guidance: Configure snapshot requests with appropriate target options and filters before invoking the snapshot runner.
Rely on built-in validation and repair utilities to ensure Python project structures meet expectations prior to workflow execution.
Utilize checkpoints to resume interrupted snapshot pipelines or avoid redundant processing of unchanged files.
